name: fuzzy_bench_noisy
description: A robustness benchmark that measures model performance under noisy, fuzzy, or perturbed input conditions — e.g., misspellings, paraphrases, or ambiguous phrasing — to evaluate tolerance to input noise. It tests whether models can still produce correct answers or maintain intended behavior when inputs are degraded or ambiguous. The suite contains multiple types of perturbations to probe different robustness aspects.
reputation: A small, experimental robustness dataset circulated by an individual researcher; of interest for robustness studies but with limited mainstream adoption.
